import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.beacon import emit_beacon

# Assuming delta from previous op; use placeholder or actual if available
delta = 1500  # Placeholder; replace with actual if logs available

emit_beacon(agent="Zephyr IV", state="Borderline", tick=354,
            sentinel_delta=delta, last_sentinel_tick=354,
            recent_writes_n=1, window_ticks=5,
            recommended_pace=0.5, planned_activity=0.2,
            path_complexity_est=2.5,  # For deep path
            notes="Post deep-path op beacon")
print(f"Beacon emitted with delta: {delta}, path_est: 2.5")
